title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu prepares food for Kanmani and persuades her to eat for her unborn baby. Kanmani later feels delighted upon receiving her share from the health mix powder sales.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi uncovers footage of Ranjitham selling Paraman's jewellery and confronts her. Kumaresan finds Ilamathi sleeping in the kitchen and urges Paraman to build a life with her.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna plots to have Vetri and Abinaya jailed. Meanwhile, Shanmugam reveals Sudar's love for Vetri, who later receives Parvathy's diary and cooks for Sudar.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi learns that Poongodi is visiting every house to clear Mayandi's family of the accusations. Seeing their wedding photograph, Manjamalai longs for Pechi's presence.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
episodeTitle: Lakshmi's Desire for a Movie Outing
description: Lakshmi stubbornly asks for walking shoes, prompting Ragavan to mock her by giving her his old pair. When Lakshmi demands to watch a movie at the theatre, Mathi assures her.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan breaks down to Palanivel, worried about Thangamayil's stay. Though he asks her to leave, Pandian and Gomathi stand by her and insist she stay.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: With love and blessings surrounding them, Cheran and Chandayatha happily tie the knot. Soon, the joyous wedding celebration reaches its peak with spectacular dance performances.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu decides to attend Sathya's reception, planning to make a remarkable impression. Meanwhile, Vijaya reluctantly welcomes Rohini home and forbids others from helping her.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Eshwari overhears Sethupathi's lottery scheme and humiliates Tamizhselvi by calling the car alms. Tamizhselvi is stunned to uncover the truth behind the fake lottery scheme.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri surprises Karthik at midnight and celebrates his birthday with joy. But her happiness turns to heartbreak when he confesses his love for Priya and awaits her response.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira tells Lakshmi about her new bike taxi job, while Lakshmi teases Kandhasamy over mehendi leaves. Sarasu applies mehendi for the family, choosing to skip it herself.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 5: The First Eviction Stuns All
description: Vinoth becomes leader and names three weakest performers. Eviction voting sends one out, while the Review Board puts Lakshmipriya in danger.
